scope: Matched from-scratch reconstruction/correspondence experiment; not a constitutive physics milestone
recipe: Original repaired C1 architecture, image/physics losses, optimizer and full LR schedule; genuinely new random model, no historical trained tensors
activation_selection: First common-prefix candidate passing unchanged training-only binding gates; retain failed attempts; no validation or test outcome selects activation; fail explicitly if none passes
topology: Unmodified C1 densify/prune stops before15000; coverage_density=false and affine_weight=0; fresh bindings after topology stabilizes; no historical Gaussian row IDs are reused
binding: Recompute full native color-adjoint contributions and local banks from the fresh common full state. Reuse only model-independent training images, LK triangulation, component continuity and frozen raw FB flow; retain all v1 reliability gates
validation: Fixed schedule every5000 updates; no final checkpoint selection by test; both final complete states at50000
evaluation: Validation30 and test50 native image metrics; three fixed cameras2/86/188 x all200 times plus moving control; partial geometric diagnostics and own fresh early-bank retention; no dense novel-view pseudo GT or physical ID accuracy
interpretation: One seed and scene; previous test exposure is known. Compare S1 against matched S0; report failures and covariance/coverage tradeoffs, not only favorable proxies
historical_protection: No writes to PIDG/C1/T1/O1/U0/U1 histories, old bindings, reports or outputs
